sources.title: Burkina Faso: travel and security advice
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Federal Foreign Office guidance expressly addresses entry for German nationals, requires online pre-travel visa application, and distinguishes the exceptional arrival request.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Das Visum muss vor Reiseantritt online beantragt werden.

sources.title: Iran: travel and security advice

sources.supportingExcerpt: Das Visum kann bei Einreise an den Flughäfen Queen Alia International und Aqaba auch „on arrival“ beantragt werden.

sources.supportingExcerpt: Dieses muss vor der Einreise ... bei der Botschaft der Republik Sudan in Berlin, beantragt werden.

sources.title: Syria: travel and security advice

sources.supportingExcerpt: Das Visum sollte ... bei der syrischen Botschaft in Berlin, beantragt werden.

sources.title: Sierra Leone Immigration Department: visa services FAQ

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: German ordinary-passport visitors must obtain Burkina Faso's electronically issued short-stay visa before travel.
conditions: Apply online before travel; the Federal Foreign Office says a visa-on-arrival request is accepted only in urgent exceptional cases and is not reliable for a normal visitor baseline.
The official Burkina Faso embassy guidance says approved applicants receive the EVISA document by email and present it at the border.
This excludes work, residence, transit, diplomatic or special documents, the separate entry-form QR code, and final admission.

application.label: Visa Burkina official eVisa service
steps: Apply online for the intended short-stay visitor visa before travel.
Receive the approved EVISA document by email and present it at entry.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Iran electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Germany's current official guidance says the Iranian visa for a German national is electronically issued and can be applied for online before entry.
conditions: Carry the electronically issued visa as a printout; it is not placed in the passport.
The same guidance says that the reliability of the arrival-visa process since the COVID-19 pandemic is not confirmed and urgently advises against relying on it.
This excludes German-Iranian dual nationals, non-tourist purposes, exit-visa procedures, security conditions, and final admission.

application.label: Iran Ministry of Foreign Affairs eVisa service
steps: Apply online before entry using the German ordinary passport to be used for travel.
Carry the electronically issued visa printout and meet Iranian entry requirements.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: German ordinary-passport visitors can obtain Jordan's visitor visa on arrival at the named airports and certain land crossings.
conditions: Arrival issuance is available at Queen Alia International Airport and Aqaba Airport; the guidance also names Aqaba/Yitzhak Rabin and Sheikh Hussein Bridge for arrival issuance.
Entry via King Hussein Bridge from the West Bank requires a visa applied for online before entry; that route is a material exception, not a nationality-wide replacement for the airport arrival route.
Purpose, passport validity, payment, route operations, stays over 14 days, security conditions and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: German ordinary-passport visitors must obtain the Sudanese visa before entry through the competent Sudanese mission.
conditions: For Germany-based applicants, the current guidance identifies the Embassy of the Republic of Sudan in Berlin.
This does not normalize travel warnings, airport operations, registration after entry, travel permits, non-visitor purposes, special documents or final admission.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Syria advance visitor visa
policies.summary: German ordinary-passport visitors require a Syrian visa applied for through the competent Syrian foreign mission before travel.
conditions: For an applicant resident in Germany, the current guidance identifies the Syrian Embassy in Berlin.
Visa issuance is not always possible at Syrian land crossings; this does not establish an electronic or dependable arrival-visa route.
This excludes Israeli-document restrictions, transit, work, residence, special documents, operational access and final admission.

conflicts.explanation: Current German Foreign Office guidance says the visa is electronically issued and that an online eVisa can be applied for before entry; it says arrival-visa reliability is unconfirmed and advises against it.

Current German Foreign Office guidance requires German nationals to apply through the competent Syrian foreign mission, specifically the Syrian Embassy in Berlin for Germany-based applicants, and says border issuance is not always possible.

No opened current Afghan authority source establishes a German ordinary-passport visitor route and actual issuance timing, so visa_required is not inferred from the stale description.

The current Federal Foreign Office page contains no German-national visa-issuance instruction, and the current Niger MFA entry page could not be opened during this review. No complement-by-omission or exceptional point-of-entry route is normalized as a German ordinary-passport rule.
